items.headline: Anthropic donates Agent Skills to a neutral foundation, and 70+ apps already use it
items.summary: Agent Skills are simple folders of instructions that teach an AI assistant how to do a specific job your way. Anthropic gave the open standard to the Agentic AI Foundation, and more than 70 platforms, including ChatGPT, Cursor and GitHub Copilot, already support it.
items.why_it_matters: A skill you write once for Claude can follow you to other AI tools, so the time you spend teaching an AI your process isn't locked into one company.

opportunity.angle: I built one skill and used it in three different AI apps

items.headline: Anthropic gives governments a 40% discount on Claude through GSA deal
items.summary: A new agreement with the U.S. General Services Administration cuts the price of Claude Enterprise, Claude for Government and the API by 40% for federal, state, local and tribal buyers.
items.why_it_matters: It's aimed at government, not you, but it shows Claude is becoming standard business software, which supports its staying power if you build on it.
